cim: Opinion | SI is the future of AI – just not in the way Trump thinks
cim_eredeti: Opinion | SI is the future of AI – just not in the way Trump thinks
szoveg_eredeti:
The next big leap in AI will come from self-intelligence: systems able to recognise what they don’t know, acquire that knowledge and decide how to act safely

Producing an intelligent answer is vastly different from independently acquiring knowledge, deciding what to do and acting appropriately in an unpredictable world. I believe the next great challenge for AI is moving from machine learning towards achieving machine self-intelligence.
